| SORT assertions DESC

query.esql:
FROM logs-circl.kev-*
| WHERE vulnerability.id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL catalog = COALESCE(event.provider, "unattributed")
| STATS listed_at = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), vendor = VALUES(circl.kev.vendor), product = VALUES(circl.kev.product) BY vulnerability.id, catalog
| STATS first_listed = MIN(listed_at), last_updated = MAX(last_seen), catalogs = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(catalog)), ", "), catalog_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(catalog), tags = VALUES(CONCAT(TO_STRING(listed_at), "#", catalog)), vendor = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(vendor)), ", "), product = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(product)), ", ") BY vulnerability.id
| MV_EXPAND tags
| EVAL parts = SPLIT(tags, "#")
| EVAL listed_on = TO_DATETIME(MV_FIRST(parts)), catalog = MV_LAST(parts)
| WHERE listed_on == first_listed
| STATS first_catalog = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(catalog)), ", "), first_listed = MIN(first_listed), last_updated = MAX(last_updated), catalogs = MAX(catalogs), catalog_count = MAX(catalog_count), vendor = MAX(vendor), product = MAX(product) BY vulnerability.id
| SORT first_listed DESC
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-circl.kev-*
| WHERE vulnerability.id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL catalog = COALESCE(event.provider, "unattributed")
| STATS listed_at = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), vendor = VALUES(circl.kev.vendor), product = VALUES(circl.kev.product) BY vulnerability.id, catalog
| STATS first_listed = MIN(listed_at), last_updated = MAX(last_seen), catalogs = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(catalog)), ", "), catalog_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(catalog), tags = VALUES(CONCAT(TO_STRING(listed_at), "#", catalog)), vendor = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(vendor)), ", "), product = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(product)), ", ") BY vulnerability.id
| MV_EXPAND tags
| EVAL parts = SPLIT(tags, "#")
| EVAL listed_on = TO_DATETIME(MV_FIRST(parts)), catalog = MV_LAST(parts)
| WHERE listed_on == first_listed
| STATS first_catalog = MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(VALUES(catalog)), ", "), first_listed = MIN(first_listed), last_updated = MAX(last_updated), catalogs = MAX(catalogs), catalog_count = MAX(catalog_count), vendor = MAX(vendor), product = MAX(product) BY vulnerability.id
| SORT first_listed DESC
| LIMIT 100

embeddableConfig.description: Every vulnerability with the catalog that listed it first, the catalogs that list it, and when, most recently first listed at the top. When catalogs tie for the exact same earliest timestamp, all tied catalogs are shown.
